title: Integrate UEFF target architecture with embedded CFF, mutual obligations and warranty conditions
decision: Integrate CFF as an internal domain of the unified UEFF within the existing ORCHESTRATION_WORKFLOW_FABRIC platform service, including actual-need analysis, competent fulfillment, time-scoped and conditional resources, contracting, mutual obligations, acceptance, statutory/voluntary warranty distinctions and dispute handling. Set future durable execution engine choice to OPEN while preserving Temporal as the existing operational engine/authority until a separately approved proven migration.
owner_approval_basis: Owner approved UEFF v1.0 conceptual architecture in the originating conversation.
Owner explicitly requested inclusion of responsibility, mutual commitment, commissioning/acceptance and warranty-condition enforcement.
Owner explicitly approved incorporating the corrected UEFF into the CFA3 plan and approved opening the future durable engine selection while preserving current Temporal-based operation.
